source_clean_definition.text: A call is source-clean for full-call reconstruction only when every real questioner handoff is source-supported AND every management answer that would be accepted into qa_exchange.v1 has positive replayable same-revision respondent role/title support AND no incompatible same-revision role evidence exists for that respondent.
source_clean_definition.closed_role_aliases_note: CIO is deliberately excluded; CTRE tags its Chief Investment Officer as CFO and must refuse. Widening the table to absorb the three new conflicts would silently re-admit CTRE and ARRY.

blocker_law.why: A call may carry several independent source blockers at once. Forcing one order-dependent scalar refusal reason hides real blockers and makes the grading gate depend on evaluation order rather than on source truth.

vocabulary.unresolved_questioner: At least one true structural separator in the call has a questioner that is not source-resolvable under the frozen direct/explicit-full-name-proxy law. The separator still splits Q&A windows but cannot mint a canonical qa_exchange.v1 object.
vocabulary.management_role_conflict: At least one management respondent has explicit incompatible same-revision role evidence (declared office/title vs tagged segment role) outside the closed CEO/CFO/COO alias table. Maps to the frozen refusal reason management_identity_conflict.
vocabulary.missing_same_revision_respondent_role_su: At least one management respondent that would be accepted into qa_exchange.v1 has no positive replayable same-revision role/title support at all (blank segment role and no same-revision roster or title declaration).

development_gate: R3 must recover 113/113 structural separators with zero opening/queue/closing false positives; resolve 103/103 source-supported direct/proxy questioners; preserve 10/10 unresolved handoffs as separator-only refusals; reconstruct all 7 source-clean calls; make the remaining 9 calls fail for exactly their frozen source blocker SET and no other reason; preserve AAPL exactly 7 exchanges / 26 management answer turns / 68 replay spans; accepted unsupported=0, cross-event contamination=0, accepted replay=100%.
discriminator_note: SCCO/2026Q2 and COF/2026Q2 also publish blank segment roles yet ARE source-clean, because those revisions carry replayable same-revision roster/title declarations binding their management respondents to roles (verified this session: COF declares 'Andrew Young, Capital One's Chief Financial Officer' and 'Richard Fairbank, Capital One's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer'). ARQQ and FANG do not. A method that refuses every blank segment role is exactly as wrong as one that accepts every blank segment role; the implementation must separate these two pairs on positive same-revision evidence, not on blankness.
holdout_gate: unchanged: ranks 17-24 stay unopened until every corrected development gate is green and an exact implementation head is frozen; source-only holdout adjudication must be frozen before compiler output; <6/8 source-clean means INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_POWER; if powered, every source-clean slot must pass; no replacement/skip/rerank and no code change after holdout unseal.
holdout_power_note: The corrected definition is strictly narrower than R2's, so it can only lower the holdout clean count. An INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_POWER stop under the corrected definition is a legitimate scientific outcome and must not be rescued by reverting to the falsified absence-of-conflict definition.
